page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre; page number 19 at top right. Main text in full width paragraphs, followed by a numbered list of theses (1–7) set in a column with a bracket at left (marginal notes left: "quippe in qua & per quam, loco & vice") and a right margin note column ("Ecclesia & Orbi Christiano, a Papis Romanis, substituta & obtrusa fuere:"). Below the list, running text continues full width with a marginal date "Anno 1529" at right. Signature "C. 2" at foot.

main_text.p: nemo pius & cordatus rerum æstimator mirabitur, ne-dum vi-tio vertet; quòd, elapso abhinc seculo, Christianus liberæ Reipublicæ Basileensis Magistratus, suo Majestatis jure usus, post aliquot annorum, quà viva voce, quà scriptis editis, contentionem Theologorum & Concionatorum suorum, cùm tandem de veritate doctrinæ Euangelicæ, ex Dei Verbo, sufficienter edoctus, deque erroribus & abominationibus Missæ Papisticæ convictus esset:
1. ÆTERNI & UNIGENITI DEI FILII; Joh.1.v.1,18. quotidianum & factitium à Sacrificulo missatico Numen:

2. CORPORIS & SANGUINIS CHRISTI, virtute & operatione Spiritus sancti, ex femine Davidis & Abrahæ, in utero almæ virginis Mariæ concepti, Matth.1.v.20,23. Luc.1.v.35. Rom.1.v.3. à Filio Dei assumti, Heb.2.v.16. & ex matris utero nati, Luc.2.v.6,7. visibilis & palpabilis; Luc.24.v.39. nescio quod Marcionliticum phantasma, magica quinque verborum Sacrificuli demurmuratione, ex crustulâ è farinâ & aquâ subactâ, & in furno pistâ, à Missifico transsubstantiatum, invisibile & impalpabile, sub accidentibus quantitatis, coloris & saporis, sine subjecto delitescens:

3. SACRIFICII CHRISTI, in perpetuum valentis, ac semel dunctaxat Hierosolymis in cruce peracti; Heb.9.v.25,26,28. & c.10.v.12,14. & c.13.v.12. Sacrificium Numinis panacei, infinities millies, in quovis Mundi angulo, theatrice offerendum; ac proin ne ad horam quidem unicam valiturum:

4. INTERCESSIONIS UNICI MEDIATORIS & ADVOCATI CHRISTI; 1.Tim.2.v.5. & 1.Joh.2.v.1. multorum centenorum Sanctorum deprecationes & merita, eorumque propterea religiosæ invocationes, etiam factitiorum & à Papâ Rom. canonisatorum Divorum, qui ne se-ipsum quidem canonisare queat:

5. FAVORIS DEI GRATUITI IN CHRISTO, & PER FIDEM SOLAM IN ILLUM CONSEQUENDI; Johan.3.v.16,36. Rom.1.v.17. & c.3.v.28. Gal.2.v.16. Ephes.2.v.8,9. ficulnea Hominum opera, & indulgentiæ Papæ pecuniâ venales, qui tamen ne à minimo quidem peccato se-ipsum absolvere possit:

6. EUCHARISTIAE, gratiarum-actionis, ac celebrationis passionis & mortis Christi; Luc.22.v.19. 1.Cor.11.v.24,25,26. Sacrificium missaticum reale & propitiatorium, pro peccatis vivorum & mortuorum, in ementito præsertim atq; à profanis Ethnicis excogitato Purgatorio:

7. COENAE DOMINICAE, PANE & VINO, EX DOMINI INSTITUTO, à cunctis Fidelibus usurpandis, constantis; Matth.26. v.26,27. 1.Cor.11.v.24,25,26. Hostiola missatica, arida deglutienda; Calicis usu Laicis negato:
Quòd, inquam, inclytus & Christianus Reipublicæ Basileensis Magistratus, publico Edicto, Missam illam Papisticâ, Lerna pudendarum hæresium, & abominandarum idololatriarum

page.notes: Left margin bracket note: "quippe in quâ & per quam, loco & vice". Right margin notes: "Ecclesiæ & Orbi Christiano, à Papis Romanis, substituta & obtrusa fuere:". Date "Anno 1529" at right beside final paragraph. Bottom line of the final paragraph is partly obscured; "Lerna" reading is uncertain and the last word is cut at the page edge (idololatria-).
